caption: the iron fist tournament in your pocket - the biggest tekken roster, ghost battles included.
about: Tekken 6 (2009) holds the series' largest roster on any platform at its release - around forty fighters - and the psp port keeps all of them at full speed: the rage system, the scenario campaign's beat-em-up layer trimmed to handheld scope, and the ghost-battle grind that made the portable version a time sink of its own. It is the definitive tekken for handheld play.
No windows build exists for this port, so the platform is psp - played through ppsspp, rom sourced from romsfun.

req.note: at target - the psp build runs through ppsspp within the haswell bar.
